name: VTEC (Vibrantix Trust Edge Connector)
description: On-premises edge connector fleet (Go binary + vtec-management-service) for OT/air-gapped evidence collection: mTLS bootstrap/rotation, credential relay via Vault, 9-stage edge pipeline (mask/compress/encrypt before anything leaves the network), offline buffering, Prometheus monitoring, and the client-panel fleet/workflow/credentials UI. See Architecture/VTEC/VTEC_IT_LAN_P1_ADAPTERS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.
